nodes.title: Jamie Burkart with a clipboard at 250 Broadway, 2026

nodes.title: Civic, cultural, and technical translation
nodes.summary: Cross-project capacity to carry knowledge among lived cultural experience, public institutions, data, software, and operational artifacts without collapsing their differences.

nodes.title: Implementation, Adoption, and Handoff
nodes.summary: Cross-project capability for moving useful structures into real use while keeping implementation, adoption, transfer, and durability as separate evidence states.

nodes.title: Implementation and operational stewardship
nodes.summary: Cross-project capacity to move from ambiguous conditions to working systems, then maintain, document, correct, and transfer them responsibly.

nodes.title: Participatory public systems
nodes.summary: Capability connecting facilitation, information design, technical implementation, public events, and institutional follow-through.

nodes.title: Technical Operations
nodes.summary: Turning ambiguous, cross-functional work into traceable decisions, usable operating documentation, implementation support, and durable handoffs.

nodes.title: Jamie completed a bounded prepublication report review
nodes.summary: Candidate claim that Jamie reviewed an Action Lab report for factual accuracy, source clarity, methods and claim scope, with explicit limits on authorship and analysis.

nodes.title: CallNYC was an independent CouncilStat follow-on
nodes.summary: After the fuller CouncilStat dataset was released, Jamie independently built CallNYC as a public-facing interpretation of constituent-services records.

nodes.title: Shared NYC Artist Coalition advocacy operating playbook
nodes.summary: Jamie and Julia Fredenburg co-authored a working guide that made a listening-to-action civic operating method explicit and reusable.

nodes.title: CallNYC chronology correction
nodes.summary: Corrects the project chronology from 2014-2015 to 2016.

nodes.title: CallNYC issue pathways for public constituent-services data
nodes.summary: Bounded reconstruction of Jamie's independent choice to interpret public CouncilStat records as resident-facing issue pages and next-step guidance.

nodes.title: Harry J. Epstein continuity-oriented modernization
nodes.summary: Bounded reconstruction of an implementation approach that translated inherited store knowledge into digital commerce and operations without treating continuity as obsolete.

nodes.title: KC Town Hall listening within fieldwork
nodes.summary: Bounded reconstruction of the choice to let restoration activity and neighborhood encounters inform an evolving public-use vision rather than treating preliminary programming as settled.

nodes.title: Knowledge Wiki depth with selective public projection
nodes.summary: Current governance decision to maintain a deep public-safe professional knowledge bank while projecting only purpose-fit, reviewed material into the portfolio.

nodes.title: Open House communal governance inside negotiated boundaries
nodes.summary: Bounded reconstruction of the choice to make shared responsibility and changing participant use part of Open House while negotiating institutional operating limits.

nodes.title: Use the East River photograph in the Layout B homepage working edition
nodes.summary: Jamie-authorized working-review decision to retain the East River hero and correct creator credit while production and indexing remain open.

nodes.title: Withhold intimate gathering photographs from the Layout B edition
nodes.summary: First-class no-photo decision preserving intimacy, consent, and compositional restraint in the current working edition.

nodes.title: Layout B photographic portfolio edition, July 2026
nodes.summary: Dated working edition containing six governed derivatives and explicit production, indexing, rights, and protected-absence gates.

nodes.title: Employment context coverage baseline - July 18, 2026
nodes.summary: Public-safe baseline for career-trajectory and source-channel coverage; protected evidence is represented only by boundaries and opaque metadata.

nodes.title: Knowledge Wiki retrieval tasks
nodes.summary: Human task protocol for testing whether the Wiki is actually usable.

nodes.title: NYC Artist Coalition shared-folder production evals
nodes.summary: Deterministic and human criteria for complete accounting, safe promotion, collective credit, application usefulness, and selective public projection.

nodes.title: East River homepage curatorial proposal
nodes.summary: Versioned curatorial proposal preserving blind and contextual passes, a lead, an alternative, and a production hold without granting publication authority to the panel.

nodes.title: Photography working notebook evaluation
nodes.summary: Executable contract preserving the photography notebook as a generative, source-returnable, private-by-default, human-governed working space rather than an automatic publication pipeline.

nodes.title: Photography residency proposal evaluation
nodes.summary: Executable contract ensuring that the first-pass residency proposal creates protected time and permission to discover rather than a productivity contract, aesthetic rubric, or publication shortcut.

nodes.title: Photography studio connection evaluation
nodes.summary: Executable contract proving that the first private Apple Photos contact is real, workspace-bounded, locally inspected, fail-closed, independently verified, and still held from publication.
